integrity: The pointwise at-most-one property of the binary digit construction is prior work and not claimed as new. Full coverage, the infinite-support equivalence, the sharp bounded-gap witness-height characterization, and the controlled-height power-law consequence are the assessed claim; finite computations corroborate but do not prove it.
limitations: Classification only for complementary fixed-base positional digit sets, not all perfect difference pairs. The explicit height constant is sufficient, not generally optimal. No fixed leading constants for power-law counting functions are claimed. Earlier unindexed signed-digit literature could contain an equivalent statement.
title: Perfect subtractive digit tilings and the bounded-gap height criterion
